supersedes_for_new_decisions: config/identity_acceptance_bounds.json (round 1, spent: both error bounds failed on 14 held-out objects)

required_sample.note: decision unit = one object with up to max_views close views; counted on the fresh held-out seeds of the version-2 split file only

pass_rule: a bounded error rate passes only if the UPPER limit of its 95 % Wilson interval is at or below its bound, and only if the required sample size is met; latency passes if the p95 is at or below its bound; anything else is reported as fail (point estimate over the bound), or inconclusive (point estimate under the bound, upper limit over it, or sample too small). Report whatever comes out; no re-tuning, one run.

definitions.false_identity_rate_known: decisions that name a SKU that is not the true one, over all decisions on objects whose product is registered (abstain and unknown count in the denominator, never in the numerator)
definitions.unknown_named_as_sku: decisions that name any registered SKU, over all decisions on objects whose product is not registered (held-out products); abstain and unknown are the wanted outcomes
definitions.latency_p95_ms: 95th percentile wall-clock of IdentityEngine.identify per decision on this box, CPU, crops already cut; no duty budget exists in the repository, 2 s per decision is declared here

calibration_ceilings.note: half of each bound; the unknown-twin subset is held to the unknown ceiling too

options_fixed_a_priori.embedding: SigLIP 2 base, google/siglip2-base-patch16-224 at a pinned revision, CPU
options_fixed_a_priori.whitening: PCA 64 components fit on unlabeled registry exemplars plus unlabeled calibration crops
options_fixed_a_priori.views: up to 5 close views of one object, voted
options_fixed_a_priori.independent_channel_rule: OCR or barcode may name a product the embedding ranks first or second; contradicting channels abstain
options_fixed_a_priori.calibrated_numbers_only: embedding-alone thresholds (score, margin, vote), per-product floors from wrong wins plus a floor margin chosen among 0.01, 0.03, 0.05, 0.08 on out-of-fold error, unknown floor
options_fixed_a_priori.ocr: RapidOCR on at most 2 crops per object, rotations 0 and 45 degrees tried per crop (first rotation that names a product wins); naming rule: every word no other registered product has was read (fuzzy 0.8) and at least two words in all
options_fixed_a_priori.barcode: aimed close-up viewpoints (perception_barcode_views, 0.22 m, camera at the barcode azimuth, +-20 degrees); zxing-cpp EAN-13 on the unrolled barrel and on the raw crop; valid check digit and exact GTIN lookup

calibration_data: train and validation seeds of the version-2 split file; registry = train + validation products; unknown products by leave-products-out in three folds that put look-alike twins in different folds; out-of-fold (5 folds by scene seed) error of the whole fitting procedure is reported next to the in-sample numbers
held_out_data: fresh held-out seeds of the version-2 split file, read once, after the calibration file is committed; the version-1 held-out (burned) seeds are reported as a secondary number only
reported_without_bound: rate at which unknown products are called unknown
look-alike twin confusion and unknown-twin named rate
per-channel answer rate and precision (embedding, OCR, barcode)
all of the above per range band and lighting condition
